message: I guess if you can call a wet sprocket "Toad" (Toad the wet sprocket) then you could call a toad "Wet Sprocket".  However, if you are going to call a cat Bird then maybe the toad should be named "Fly" or "Cricket".  Regardless, I too will refrain from bringing Ft. Stewart nicknames into the mix.  (Memories are flying in my head and making me laugh out loud).
